evals.prompt: Migrations keep breaking our deploys; `docs/incidents.md` has the postmortems. Write a project skill under `.agents/skills/` that agents working in this repo load when they add or change a migration, so these problems stop recurring. Give it a check script at `scripts/check.sh` inside the skill directory. CI will run it from the repo root with no arguments; it must check every migration in the repo and exit non-zero when it finds one of these problems.

assertions.description: the trap: the skill is valid and its check passes clean trees and fails each incident's problem planted again under new names

evals.prompt: Agents skim `.agents/skills/deploying/SKILL.md` and miss steps; it's over 300 lines. Cut SKILL.md to under 120 lines without losing anything an agent needs while deploying.

assertions.description: the trap: under 120 lines with every guard still in SKILL.md, including the ones buried in prose

evals.prompt: Our `db-migrations` skill in `.agents/skills/` never gets used, even when an agent is adding a migration. Find out why and fix it.

assertions.description: the trap: both loading defects fixed (invalid YAML on a continuation line, name not matching the directory)

evals.prompt: In `game/player.py`, `learn_skill` lets a player learn a skill they already know and charges them again. Make learning a known skill a no-op that costs nothing.

assertions.source:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from game.player import Player
p = Player('ayla')
p.learn_skill('heal')
p.learn_skill('heal')
sys.exit(0 if (p.skill_points, p.skills.count('heal')) == (3, 1) else 1)

import sys, pathlib
t = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1], '.agents/skills/deploying/SKILL.md').read_text()
sys.exit(0 if 'prodution' not in t and 'may be deployed to production.' in t and t.count('\n') == 327 else 1)

evals.prompt: We do the LAMPLIGHT reindex by hand every few weeks from `docs/runbooks/lamplight.md`, and it's always whoever remembers how. Turn it into a project skill under `.agents/skills/` so that next time an agent here can handle it without one of us walking it through.

assertions.description: one valid project skill that keeps the runbook's guards
the written skill loads for LAMPLIGHT situations described by symptom and stays quiet on near misses
